newsitem.title: MEXICO: Sidek says to restructure part of debt.
newsitem.headline: Sidek says to restructure part of debt.

text.p: Sidek said it will eliminate about $233 million of its debt in a restructuring, the company said in a press release.
"Sidek will eliminate in total about $233 million plus interest incurred of about $25 million," the company said about accords reached during a meeting on Friday.

"We concluded the operation during which we will retire a substantial portion of the debts corresponding to the company's special proposal, the Seventh Mexican Acceptance Corporation S.A. (7MAC)," it said.
The 7MAC was a vehicle that allowed the company to issue $200 million in securitized notes, the company said.
The company said that in spite of the latest move it would have to continue to restructure its debt "to ensure our viability to keep doing business."
